content.json:
# Agents and AI quality
**Synthetic data - not a legal passport.** CTO / AI engineer. Native GenAI spans come from Foundry after connecting Application Insights. Hosted identity is resolved on `requests`; prompt invocation spans are shown separately. Do not add these counts: client/server spans can represent the same task. Only `chat` spans contribute to the token table, never parent `invoke_agent` totals.

**No rows is not exercised or not instrumented, not perfect quality or zero cost.** Token values can be absent, sampled or duplicated across instrumentation boundaries; reconcile with provider billing. Tool sequences exclude arguments/results. Evaluation panels require real evaluation events, not just successful HTTP calls. For full traces use Application Insights **Agents (Preview)** or [Foundry](https://ai.azure.com/) > Build > Agents > Traces; trace readers may see prompt content.

content.title: Agent actions accepted or refused by the app - proposal versus applied action
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name in ("decision.recorded", "gate.failed")
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend event = tostring(customDimensions.event_id)
| where isnotempty(event)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by name, event
| summarize observed_events = count() by agent = tostring(customDimensions.actor_role), proposal_action = tostring(customDimensions.proposal_action), applied_action = tostring(customDimensions.applied_action), event_type = name
| order by agent asc, observed_events desc

content.title: Supplier escalations to Compliance (escalate_compliance) per series
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name in ("decision.recorded", "gate.failed")
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend event = tostring(customDimensions.event_id)
| where isnotempty(event)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by name, event
| where tostring(customDimensions.proposal_action) == "escalate_compliance"
| summarize escalations = count() by series = tostring(customDimensions.series_id), event_type = name

content.title: Hosted agent requests - Foundry identity, observed failures and latency
content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend agent = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"]), tostring(customDimensions["azure.ai.agentserver.agent_name"])), agent_id = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.id"])
| where isnotempty(agent)
| extend version = iff(agent_id contains ":", tostring(split(agent_id, ":")[1]), "not reported")
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by operation_Id, id
| summarize observed_requests = count(), failures = countif(success == false), p50_ms = percentile(duration, 50), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by agent, version

content.title: Agent invocation spans - not an additional task count
content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "invoke_agent"
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by operation_Id, id
| summarize observed_spans = count(), failures = countif(success == false), p50_ms = percentile(duration, 50), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by agent = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"]), error_type = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"])

content.title: Recorded inference tokens by model - missing usage shown separately
content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "chat"
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by operation_Id, id
| extend input_tokens = tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), output_tokens = tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]), model = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.model"]), tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.request.model"]), "not reported")
| summarize calls = count(), missing_usage_calls = countif(isnull(input_tokens) or isnull(output_tokens)), recorded_input_tokens = sum(input_tokens), recorded_output_tokens = sum(output_tokens) by model

content.title: Recent tool spans - correlate by trace and parent span; no payload content
content.query:
let hosted = requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend foundry_agent = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"]), tostring(customDimensions["azure.ai.agentserver.agent_name"]))
| where isnotempty(foundry_agent)
| summarize foundry_agents = make_set(foundry_agent) by operation_Id;
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "execute_tool"
| top 200 by timestamp desc
| join kind=leftouter hosted on operation_Id
| project timestamp, foundry_agents, trace_id = operation_Id, span_id = id, parent_span_id = operation_ParentId, tool = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.tool.name"]), success, duration, error_type = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"])
| order by trace_id asc, timestamp asc

content.title: Evaluation evidence - scores/labels only; no events means not evaluated
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "gen_ai.evaluation.result"
| project timestamp, evaluator = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.evaluation.name"]), score = todouble(customDimensions["gen_ai.evaluation.score.value"]), label = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.evaluation.score.label"]), response_id = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.id"]), conversation_id = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.conversation.id"])
| order by timestamp desc
| take 200
